title: Iron Legion visibility rules (content/rules/visibility.json5)
description: Engine tunables for line of sight and fog of war (Simulation Spec 11 and 15.1). One merged object per enabled mod set; every field is required because the engine carries no numeric defaults.

period_ticks.description: Ticks between visibility updates per faction (SIM-VIS-004).

conceal_radius.description: Metres within which a concealed regiment is still seen (SIM-VIS-003).

height_bonus.description: Line-of-sight radius bonus at full height advantage (SIM-VIS-001).

eye_height.description: Metres above the ground for line-of-sight segments (SIM-VIS-002).

los_sample.description: Metres between heightmap samples along a sight line (SIM-VIS-002).

memory_ticks.description: Ticks a last-seen position is remembered for UI ghosts (SIM-VIS-005).
